title: feat(console): page header on reports and custom pages; the shell's top-right button group, off while the top bar stands (#36111)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3Foa18FuRJceP6yJW5pgFF)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVcCRGjxwhDjrRVYsY

Fixes #36111

Clause-②: yes (widening): `@object-ui/components` adds one export, `PageTitleHostContext` (re-measured on the built `dist/index.d.ts`). Nothing is removed or re-typed.
Metadata-protocol: none

Maintainer ruling on the custom-page header: [#36111 ruling record](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36111#issuecomment-7064921354) (option A: the shared header on every custom page, the renderer's own page title folded into it, authored content drawn as written).

## 维护者速读

- 报表页、报表目录页、自定义页面（分区页面、界面模式页面、html、react）现在和列表、仪表盘一样，顶部是统一的页面头部：左边页名和描述，右边是这一页自己的按钮。
- 没写标题的页面，原来平台画在正文里的大标题移进头部，只出现一次。作者自己写了标题的 `page:header` 照旧显示（文档结构上降成二级标题，外观不变）；标题和页名相同的页面会看到页名两次，这是裁定接受的代价。showcase 的 my-work、project-workspace 在本 PR 里删掉了自己那一行标题。hotcrm 销售首页另开卡。
- 右上角按钮组（评论位、「编辑应用」、AI、帮助）做成一个组件，由外壳统一放：仪表盘、报表、自定义页面放在头部按钮的后面（中间一条细竖线），列表页放在视图栏最右边 ⋮ 的后面，记录页放在导航行 ✕ 的前面。**顶栏还在的时候它默认关着**，用户看不到任何重复按钮；在浏览器里设 `localStorage['os:shell:page-actions'] = 'on'` 可以打开它检查。去掉顶栏的 #36112 会把默认改成开并删掉这个开关。手机上不画。
- 「编辑应用」：文字加一个不是铅笔的图标，窄屏（<1024）只留图标、悬停提示保留文字；打开的地方和顶栏铅笔完全相同（同一个函数算出来）；只读包显示眼睛和「在 Studio 中打开」；没有 `manage_metadata` 的人看不到。
- 自定义页面右下角的浮动「在 Studio 中编辑」铅笔：电脑宽度去掉（头部的按钮组取代它），手机宽度保留。
- 帮助菜单从顶栏抽成一个组件，顶栏和按钮组共用，内容不变。

## What changes

**The shell's top-right button group** (`@object-ui/app-shell`, new `layout/ShellPageActions.tsx`)

- `ShellPageActions`: from left to right the comments slot, 「Edit app」, the AI assistant (where the server serves it) and help. One component; the shell decides whether it is drawn, not the page.
- `ShellPageActionsScope`, mounted by `ConsoleLayout`: OFF by default (`SHELL_PAGE_ACTIONS_DEFAULT = false`) while the top bar still draws the same buttons. The browser switch `localStorage['os:shell:page-actions'] = 'on'` turns it on (every access guarded; a blocked storage reads off). Outside a scope (Home, organization pages, Studio, docs) and on a phone it is never drawn.
- 「Edit app」 reads `useAppStudioEntry`, extracted from `AppHeader`, so the group and the top bar pencil compute one gate and one target (`useStudioEntryGate` + `appStudioRoutePath`). Words beside the `Blocks` icon (the record's 「Edit」 keeps the pencil), words hidden below `lg` with the tooltip keeping them; a read-only package gets the eye and 「Open {app} in Studio」; a caller without `manage_metadata` gets nothing.
- `HelpMenu` (new `layout/HelpMenu.tsx`): the 「?」 menu lifted out of `AppHeader` unchanged, used by both hosts.

**Where each page draws it**

- `PageHeader`: after the page's own actions, behind a hairline divider; a header with no actions draws the group alone. Turned off, the header renders exactly what it did before.
- The list page (`ObjectViewBarTrailing`): since #35878 its top row is the view bar, not `PageHeader`, so the bar's right end draws the group after ⋮, behind the same hairline.
- `RecordDetailView`: in the navigation row through `RecordTopBar`'s `frame` slot, before ✕ (not in an embedded record).
- The comments slot is a prop (`comments`) for the list and record pages; nothing fills it yet. #36114's comment icon moves into it when #36112 turns the group on.

**Reports and custom pages use `PageHeader`**

- `ReportView` and `AppReportIndexView`: their bespoke title blocks become `PageHeader` (title, description, the report edit button as the page's action).
- `PageView`: from the phone breakpoint up, every custom page under `/apps/APP/page/NAME` opens with `PageHeader` (page label and description) above the page's scroller. The floating 「Edit in studio」 pencil is drawn only on a phone; a phone keeps its old face (no console header, the renderer's own title, the pencil).
- `InterfaceListPage`: new `consoleHeader` prop; the console route draws `PageHeader` with the page's configured buttons as its actions. Studio's page preview keeps the old row.

**The page renderer hands its title to the host** (`@object-ui/components`)

- New `PageTitleHostContext` (exported): while a host sets it, the page renderer skips its implicit page-name `h1` and description, as the dashboard renderer does under `hideHeaderText`.
- Internal `PageTitleDemotedContext`: under such a host, an authored titled `page:header` draws its title as `h2` with the same classes, so the document keeps one `h1` (objectui#3434). Record pages are untouched.

**Showcase**: `my-work.page.ts` and `project-workspace.page.ts` drop their `page:header` title, which repeated the page name (subtitle kept), per the ruling.

## Why

Card #36111, phase 1 of epic #36107 (remove the top bar): every in-app page needs the same header and the same top-right button group before the top bar can go. Reports and custom pages had their own headers or none; the floating pencil was a custom-page-only entry. Building the group off while the top bar stands lets this land with no visible duplication; #36112 flips it on.

## Side effects reviewers should know

- Custom pages gain a header bar (roughly 45 to 55 px of height); full-screen style pages feel it most.
- A page whose authored `page:header` title equals its name shows the name twice (header small, body large). Accepted in the ruling; hotcrm's sales home gets its own card.
- The authored `page:header` title is now an `h2` under the console header (looks the same).
- The report page and report index on a phone now draw `PageHeader` too (they had their own header block there as well).
- The three `PageView.editInStudio*` pins and the `AppHeader` objectui#12198 pin now run at a phone width, where the floating pencil still lives; what they assert is unchanged.

## Verification

- New pins: `layout/__tests__/ShellPageActions-36111.test.tsx` (switch, scope, phone, order, `PageHeader` placement / divider / off, 「Edit app」 target equals the pencil's derivation, label + icon + `lg` breakpoint, read-only eye, member gets nothing); `views/__tests__/PageView.consoleHeader-36111.test.tsx` (title once in the header, authored `page:header` stays as `h2`, group placement on/off, phone face); `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524` gains the group-before-✕ case and the off case; `ObjectView.shellPageActions-36111` pins the list view bar's end (on and off).
- Scoped runs: app-shell layout, PageView, ReportView, report index, InterfaceListPage, Dashboard, RecordDetailView top bar, components page/layout renderers: 255 files / 1,978 tests pass; re-run on the merged head after `origin/main` came in: 117 files / 1,043 tests pass.
- `pnpm run type-check` clean for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/components`; eslint 0 errors on changed files; `@objectstack/example-showcase` builds.
- Clause-② re-measured on built declarations: `PageTitleHostContext` is the one new root export.
- Screenshots (before/after for report and custom pages, the group on at list/record/dashboard/report/custom page, narrow window, light/dark) are described in the evidence comment.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (untouched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint passes on every changed file (0 errors).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 summary is for the maintainer).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
